automation.name: AI Dev Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.policy: Only public sources with a visible date strictly inside this two-day window qualify. Sources with a date only at the lower-boundary calendar day are excluded because their publication time cannot be shown to be inside the window.

federation_boundary.local_scope: AI-assisted-development practice: workflow controls, verification, governance, context, and adoption. Product and provider facts are retained only as routing notes or as evidence for a local practice implication.

qualifying_updates.source_title: Agent of the Day - October 21, 2026: Test Quality Sentinel
qualifying_updates.source_type: official GitHub Agentic Workflows project blog
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The project documents a pull-request-triggered Test Quality Sentinel that pre-fetches changed tests and functions, uses a tight read-only toolset, evaluates test-design weaknesses rather than coverage alone, and records failed runs as incomplete rather than publishing a verdict.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Treat agent review as a separately scoped, read-only quality gate. Supply a narrow evidence packet, evaluate behavioral test quality rather than line coverage, and preserve a clear failure state for human follow-up.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: Do not create local product coverage for GitHub or Copilot. Candidate ingest belongs under the local verification-and-evals lens.

qualifying_updates.source_title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: OpenAI describes a maintainer-led coordinated disclosure response in which AI-assisted vulnerability discovery was followed by fix testing, provider protection preparation, version identification guidance, and broader defender coordination before disclosure.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: An AI-found security issue needs a governed response lifecycle, not only a model finding: maintainers retain release authority, fixes and mitigations need independent preparation, and operator guidance should identify affected versions before remediation is applied.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: Route OpenAI, Codex, and PHP entity coverage upstream; retain only the local coordinated-remediation and maintainer-authority practice implication.

qualifying_updates.source_title: AI coding agents in regulated industries: residency, audit and approvals
qualifying_updates.source_type: vendor-authored practice guide; vendor and cited-provider claims require source-specific verification during ingest
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The guide frames governed coding-agent use around four operational questions: where prompts and code travel, what record remains after a session, who approves each action, and which models are allowed. It distinguishes in-session action approval from pull-request and release approval.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Keep session permissions, change approval, release authority, tool-call evidence, and data-boundary decisions as separate controls. Git history alone does not show the tools called, data targeted, or denied actions.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: All named products and protocols remain upstream-owned. Use only the local governance pattern after independently checking any provider-specific behavior.

qualifying_updates.source_title: BeyondTrust AI Agent Security Now Generally Available
qualifying_updates.source_type: vendor press release reporting vendor telemetry
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: BeyondTrust reports that agent skills and MCP connections expand the set of executable instructions and privileges on developer endpoints, and presents runtime agent-specific enforcement and policy audit as its control model.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Treat installed skills, bundled repository instructions, and MCP configuration as an auditable software supply-chain surface. Review their provenance and permissions independently from ordinary user permissions, and do not treat vendor telemetry as a general population estimate.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: BeyondTrust and MCP entity information is upstream-owned. Retain only the downstream skill-and-tool supply-chain governance implication, with the vendor-source limitation preserved.
